ja.title: RNAスコアで臨床試験はどこまで小さくなるか：POPLARの12か月無増悪生存の4つの割合を仮定した設計別の必要症例数
ja.summary: RNA基盤モデルLadonの技術報告にあるPOPLARの12か月PFS（4つの割合）が成り立つと仮定し、全員組み入れ・スコア調整・交互作用検定・濃縮の4設計の必要症例数を計算した。減るのは主に濃縮で、スコア調整は2.6%にとどまり、4つの割合の標本誤差だけで必要症例数は大きく振れる。
ja.seo_description: Ladon技術報告のPOPLARの12か月PFS（4つの割合）を入力に、全員組み入れ・スコア調整・交互作用検定・濃縮の必要症例数を計算し、標本誤差と陽性的中率への感度を調べた。
ja.seo_title: RNAスコアで臨床試験はどこまで小さくなるか

en.title: How much smaller could a trial be with an RNA-model score? Required patients by design, assuming four published POPLAR 12-month progression-free survival percentages
en.summary: Assuming the four 12-month PFS percentages for POPLAR in the Ladon technical report hold, I computed the patients needed by four designs: all-comers, score-adjusted, interaction test and enriched. Enrichment accounts for most of the reduction, adjusting for the score gives 2.6%, and the sampling error of the four percentages alone makes the numbers swing widely.
en.seo_description: Required patients for four trial designs from four POPLAR PFS12 percentages, with sampling error and sensitivity to the positive predictive value.
en.seo_title: How much smaller could a trial be with an RNA-model score?
